n, m = counts.shape
    df = (counts > 0).sum(axis=0)
    idf = np.log(n / (1.0 + df))
    X = counts * idf
    row_norms = np.linalg.norm(X, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    if (row_norms == 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Row cannot be L2-normalized after IDF scaling")
    X = X / row_norms
    ones = np.ones(n)
    d = X @ (X.T @ ones) - 1.0
    if (d <= 0).any():
        raise ValueError("Nonpositive degree detected")
    D_inv = d ** (-0.5)
    X_tilde = X * D_inv[:, None]
    def matvec(v):
        return X_tilde @ (X_tilde.T @ v) - D_inv.astype(X.dtype) * v
    A = LinearOperator((n, n), matvec=matvec, dtype=X.dtype)
    if random_state is not None:
        rng = np.random.RandomState(random_state)
        v0 = rng.uniform(size=n).astype(X.dtype)
    else:
        v0 = None
    eigenvalues, eigenvectors = eigsh(A, k=n_components, which='LM', v0=v0)
    eigenvalues = eigenvalues[::-1]
    eigenvectors = eigenvectors[:, ::-1]
    return eigenvalues, eigenvectors
